capabilities: create projects with overview notes and dashboard files
generate epics and user stories from configurable templates
assign unique content identifiers to projects, epics and stories
auto-insert backlinks between projects, epics and stories
substitute project data into templates via placeholders
extras: README is in French; an English version is linked externally. The manifest carries an unreviewed-plugin notice. The author states it serves personal needs first and may not implement suggested features.
motivation: The author developed it in a few days to meet a personal need and published it in case others needed it.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in way to set up and structure projects using traditional or agile project management methodologies.
summary: Project management plugin that scaffolds projects with overview notes, dashboard files, epics and user stories for traditional and agile workflows.
